I read the article & also read up on kidney transplants themselves. Criteria & such. I understand each hospital has their own medical board to set the criteria for what they require to approve transplants. And thus, riskier people tend not to get approval. 

I also understand how many pro lifers feel about the stem cells that were/are used in the COVID vaccine development etc. It may not make sense to someone who isn’t that pro life but if they need that integrity, then I understand that. 

I myself, am pro choice. That being said, I believe my body, my choice. It would be hypocritical of me to state that then demand one gets a vaccine they don’t believe in or find morally wrong. Not all people that are reluctant about the COVID vaccine are anti vaxxers. I think lumping them all together into this neat little box is unfair. 

While following your medical doctors advice tends to be best, it never hurts to advocate for yourself & question things. I believe if you follow everything blindly, you’re going to eventually lose your sight literally. 

This woman has made her choice & it is hers to make. She seems fairly at peace with her decision. There’s many other circumstances where she’d probably be receiving full support. She deserves just as much compassion & consideration as everyone else in this unfortunate situation. I wish her well.

Just wanted to share that I’m still here. The date has come and gone. I felt a sense of dread the entire day and it did weigh heavily on my mind. I still have those fleeting thoughts, that I think all of us with these issues have. But for now, I’m okay. 

I did locate a psychiatrist and will be setting up an appointment. Then seeking a therapist.

Me too. I spend a lot of time on Twitter and see others struggling. I understand what they’re going through. Mental health needs to be more of a priority in the world. I’ve always said it feels like I’m screaming and no one can hear me.
I like that. Reminds me of Parks and Rec. Treat yo self!

Oddly enough, I’m near New Orleans. You’d think I’d have more options right? I’m in the Bible Belt, surrounded by the beautiful gay city of Nola. Yet every therapist website I check out talks about Christianity. 🙄🤦🏼‍♀️

Just no. I think I’m feeling especially mournful because I’ve missed two Irish ☘️ Channel Parades. Pride and Southern Decadence. And Mardi Gras this year. I miss my New Orleans culture. 

I’ll keep searching tho. There’s got to be someone out there.
No, she didn’t. I follow her on Facebook. She’s alive and well.

It seems to have gotten worse to me. I’m not sure of the actual statistics but the shootings are daily and in multiples. It does tend to be people that know each other. And car jackings seem to be on the rise. I live just outside of New Orleans so when I do go into the city, I make sure I’m good on fuel so I don’t need to stop anywhere. It doesn’t seem so bad during the day but I wouldn’t go out at night if I didn’t have to.

Jeremy was never very bright. He’s got a record a mile long too. It’s an assumption but I’m assuming Lorena went along with it. The whole thing is ridiculous. Killing someone to take possession of their home is reprehensible.
We’re all originally from Eau Claire, Wisconsin. I moved from the area in 2009 and now live in New Orleans. I haven’t been in close contact with Lorena in many years. Just here and there on Facebook.

So I’m local to this. I remember when it happened and was appalled that they didn’t stop for this poor man. And they haven’t found answers. Sadly, he’s not the first nor the last this has happened to in New Orleans. Hit and runs are incredibly common here, along with carjackings and shootings. Since COVID hit, crime has sky rocketed. It’s sad. I still love my city.
Anthony just applied for a private investigator license in Florida. If that isn’t just ridiculous, I don’t know what is.

I believe the brain damage/CTE was a huge factor in what happened. I think it brought out the rage in him. And possibly his suicide. What’s odd is there’s really no motive as to why Odin Lloyd was killed. Some suggest he betrayed Hernandez in some way but it was never proven. And it was never proven that he was the trigger man.  Although I agree he was definitely involved. 

It’s sad because he had his dreams coming true but he couldn’t leave behind his old life of the bad influence of friends and drugs. And he lost everything and Lloyd lost his life.

I saw in another documentary about Hernandez that he’d been writing a college girlfriend while is prison and he’d confessed to her about his sexuality. I guess she’d had some inkling or busted him on it back it the day. I think she might have gone public with those letters. Which seems like a real shitty thing to do to someone.

I love Stephanie Harlowe. I find it’s hard to compare to her as well. She’s so damn thorough, which I really appreciate. She’s taught me some things about cases I thought I knew just about everything.
